Hi Mark — appreciate the checklist and the clarity. Per Olga's note, we've sketched two concrete scenarios below for an 8-GPU A100-equivalent pool (production traffic profile: median sequence length ~256 tokens, bursty peaks expected Nov/Dec).

Scenario A — Additive premium (shorter commit flexibility):
- Base Dedicated (8 GPUs): $42,000/mo
- Isolation surcharge: $6,000/mo (flat per-GPU isolation uplift = $750/GPU/mo)
- One-time onboarding/security config: $25,000 (includes KMS integration, isolated storage config, audit log pipeline)
- Optional: Audit-log retention 12mo included; extended retention 24mo = +$1,500/mo
- Throughput guarantees: p50 token latency 45ms, p99 token latency 210ms on the committed pool; credits: 5% monthly credit for >5% SLO breach, prorated.
- Minimum commit term: 6 months; 12 months gets 7% discount on base Dedicated line-item (not isolation surcharge).

Scenario B — Bundled premium (12/24mo preferred):
- Bundled committed price (12mo): $55,000/mo (includes KMS, audit logging 12mo retention, isolated storage, and standard onboarding)
- Bundled committed price (24mo): $51,000/mo (weighted discount for longer commit)
- One-time onboarding: waived for 24mo if signed within 30 days
- Throughput guarantees: p50 40ms, p99 180ms; stronger credit policy (10% credit cap if SLOs missed).

Notes/assumptions: these numbers assume no extra model-parameter charges and that TenantShield will use Redwood-managed model variants (if you bring custom model builds we'll need to revisit runtime performance assumptions). If you need dedicated KMS HSM keys in a VPC, add a $2,000/mo HSM fee.

I've attached a term sheet and a draft SOW for your legal/procurement review. Happy to hop on a short call to walk gaps.
